entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeaaaaah!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Everyone, raise your glass.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Allow me to say a few words... Now then...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He's started taking charge.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come now, don't be that way.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If you're gonna complain, say it to Shido.[n]A legislator's pin's worth almost nothing.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well then, so, since the source of evil,[n]Masayoshi Shido, has been—

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I got to avenge... my mom. It's all...[n]thanks... to everyone.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Thank— *sniff* *sob*

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was able to settle a debt in regard to[n]my father as well.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We all worked so hard for this...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *sniff* *sob*

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Shido's guilty, right, Sis?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...It'll be difficult to prosecute him[n]immediately.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But I'll do this thoroughly until the[n]causality between his other crimes[n]can be proven.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I believe Wakaba-san's research results[n]will save Japan.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We could testify too, you know.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Thank you, but I'll be fine. I don't want to[n]add any more unwanted suspicions on[n]any of you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's about time you let us adults prove[n]that we can get our act together.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, so what about this guy's education?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I believe it'll be fine for him to return to[n]school.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's true that your face will be recognized[n]among those involved...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But I doubt they'll take a firm action like[n]suddenly coming to arrest him.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: At least, they won't do it until the uproar[n]with your "suicide" and Shido's confession[n]have died down.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Eventually though, the situation where[n]you and I will be used as scapegoats[n]can't be avoided...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...You mean in regard to faking his death.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That wouldn't have happened to begin[n]with had the police done their job[n]properly.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Of course, I plan on doing everything[n]I can.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I will protect you all this time. Prosecuting[n]Shido is that first step.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hey... When are we going to make the[n]toast?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Right. Let's get to it!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Uhh, today is truly—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Cheeeeeers!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: No, wai— Hey!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Cheers.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I need to go. It seems Shido's been[n]transferred to a hospital.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Oh, one more thing. It's fine to celebrate,[n]but keep it in moderation, okay?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Considering that [fName]'s finally back,[n]all of you need to take your education[n]seriously again.
